paper_title: Comparing 1D and 2D Real Time on Cellular Automata
statement: Without the assumption that CA(n) = CA2 (n), it is still unknown whether CA(n) is closed under concatenation. Actually, it is also unknown whether CA(2n) is closed under concatenation and even if the concatenation of two languages in CA(n) is in CA(2n).
context: I Corollary 12. If CA(n) = CA2 (n), CA(n) is closed under concatenation. Without the assumption that CA(n) = CA2 (n), it is still unknown whether CA(n) is closed under concatenation. Actually, it is also unknown whether CA(2n) is closed under concatenation and even if the concatenation of two languages in CA(n) is in CA(2n). I Corollary 13.
